commandcode-copilot.walkthrough.title: Command Code for Copilot Chat

commandcode-copilot.config.title: Command Code Copilot
commandcode-copilot.config.baseUrl.descr: Command Code Provider API base URL. Defaults to https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1.
commandcode-copilot.config.maxTokens.des: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default (no limit). Useful for controlling costs.
commandcode-copilot.config.zdr.descripti: Send `x-cmdc-zdr: 1` on every request to enforce zero-data-retention routing. Requests only go through ZDR-capable upstreams; if a model has no ZDR upstream the request fails with HTTP 422 (`cmd_zdr_no_providers`). Disable if you hit unexpected 422s.
commandcode-copilot.config.apiKey.descri: Command Code API key (fallback). Stored values in VS Code SecretStorage take precedence; this setting is mainly for CI/automation.
commandcode-copilot.config.modelIdOverri: Map a VS Code model id to a different API model id. Useful when routing through a mirror or proxy that uses different names. Leave empty to send the upstream id as-is.
commandcode-copilot.config.modelBlacklis: Model ids to hide from the picker (matched on the VS Code model id). Useful when a mirror does not serve a specific upstream model.
commandcode-copilot.config.maxContextTok: Override the context window reported to Copilot (in tokens). Set to 0 to use each model's default. Useful when a mirror serves a model with a smaller context window than the upstream.
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.des:
Controls what diagnostic information the extension writes to the output channel.

- **Minimal** — no logs beyond the activation banner.
- **Metadata** — request/response metadata (model id, message counts, tool counts, thinking effort).
- **Verbose** — full request payloads including prompts and tool schemas. May contain sensitive content.
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.min: No logs beyond the activation banner.
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.met: Request/response metadata (model id, message counts, tool counts, thinking effort).
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.ver: Full request payloads. May contain sensitive content.
commandcode-copilot.config.modelDetailSt: Controls the text shown next to each model name in the Copilot Chat model picker.
Compact capability text on Linux, full description on other platforms.
Show the full model description next to the model name.
Show short capability text such as Vision · Thinking.
Show only the model name; the full description stays in the hover tooltip.
